Summer training camp. A crucial time to polish
Mr. C.B.'s running, which had been honed to this point.
That's what I'm talking about! Let's get right to it!

Yeah. Pretty wonderful, isn't it?
To think it crossed the ocean and traveled all the way here.

I bet even Lady Luck herself
is gonna want to keep surprising us from here on out.

The thud of luggage being set down caught my attention.
Right outside the entrance stood Mr. C.B.

Spending time together by pure chance like this felt just
like running into your best friend while on a trip—

Suddenly, Mr. C.B. came to mind.
Is this what it feels like to simply follow your heart—?

...I should let her do as she pleases. Moving freely
is the secret behind keeping her in peak condition, after all.

I went to grab some camping gear because it looked interesting.
And when I stepped out the front door, you showed up.

Yeah, thanks...! 
Haha, that really hits the spot!

Wondering if Mr. C.B. might also be interested,
I glanced over at her to see her reaction, but...

I hadn't been that interested myself, but hearing
the actual sound makes you want to see them—

Given that she hadn't reacted to the other girls' conversation,
I figured as much.

No promises made, just purely by chance, a total coincidence.
Crossing paths in the exact same place.

...Fufu, it really was pure coincidence.
You had such a surprised look on your face.
Hey, hey, let's head back and get ready!
Camping gear. Mugs, lanterns, that kind of stuff.

What a fun coincidence.
Wanna join? I've got the best seat in the house.

Yeah.
Yeah... I kinda like this. Times like these.

While watching the sunset, I noticed them setting up fireworks.
Thought it might be nice to watch them from here.

As the sun begins to set, the faint sounds of
festival music can be heard in the distance.

Sea glass.
If you look around, you'll find quite a bit of it.
Haa, haa...!

Like running into someone you had a crush on as a kid in the middle of town.
An indescribably joyful feeling welled up inside me.
Don't forget about the fireworks afterward, okay!
(Thud)

After all, someone who wants to live freely like me
managed to meet someone who dreams of that like you.

~♪
Oh, there it is.
...I was thinking maybe I'd watch the fireworks after all.

Mr. C.B. runs just the way she wants to.
And as her Trainer, I'll keep chasing that dream with her.

That glass bottle looks like it came from abroad too.
Let's check over there.
Were you heading out to see the fireworks, by any chance?
Haha, you know what I mean.

So, what's next on the menu?
I'd like to work on my upper body too.

I'll pass.
I just want to stay here and watch the sun go down.

Ooh, found a nice piece of driftwood too.
Fufu, where did you come from, I wonder?

The Umamusume dashed toward the training lodge.
Apparently, there's a festival and a fireworks display tonight.

I ate a light lunch so I'd have room for festival food~!
I'm gonna hit every single stall♪

Great view, right? We're a bit far away, but
at least there's nothing blocking the sightline.

That night—as I was working,
the sound of distant fireworks began to echo.

During training hours, we worked hard side by side.
Once that ended, though, we spent our free time however we pleased.
I put my work on pause and stepped outside to watch the fireworks.
—Ah.

Yep, found plenty.
You guys look even prettier in the glow of the sunset.
